In case of stepped ceilings abutting the partitions on the same side, then the higher of the two shall be measured for the height of the partition if the taller portion of the partition is more than 1/2 the length of the partition. Providing and laying plain cement concrete (PCC) flooring ~75mm thick on existing RCC slab. The finished floor surface shall be laid smooth without any undulation, perfectly levelled and matched with the floor finish level as specified by the Architect. 
PCC flooring shall comprise of a topping layer ~25mm thick in cement concrete ratio 1:2:3 (cement: fine aggregate/ sand: course aggregate). The concrete mix ratio, size of aggregates and volume per unit area shall be confirming to the Indian Standard (IS) codes.
Below the topping layer, a cement concrete layer of ~50mm thick, shall be provided in ratio 1:3:6 (cement: fine aggregate: coarse aggregate). The concrete mix ratio, size of aggregates and volume per unit area shall be confirming to the Indian Standard (IS) codes.
The flooring shall be laid monolithically in panels of dimension, not exceeding, 4metres across length or breadth and the other dimension of a panel shall not exceed two or three times the previous dimension. The cement concrete flooring shall be adequately cured and shall not be exposed to any traffic until hardening.  
Epoxy Coating :
All cracks / pinholes / undulation on the surface shall be sealed with epoxy based filler and the surface shall be grinded with fine sand. The surface shall be coated with resin based compound and polished to achieve desired finish as approved by the Architect / Interior Designer. 
Micro concrete coating :
Providing and laying seamless microconcrete compound made with special cements, well dispersionable polymers and select fillers. The average thickness of the compound shall be ~2-4mm. Post application of the compound with straight edge trowel, the surface shall be prepared by grinding and polishing with 120 & 180 grit. 
General :
Rate shall include supply and installation of all materials, including all requirements for preparation of substrate, priming of substrate and finishing of the floor. Rate shall also be inclusive of removal of debris, cleaning, grinding, polishing, curing, including all labour charges complete in all respects.

Providing and applying self-levelling cementitious compound of approved make, in thickness not less than ~5mm and not exceeding 40mm, as per the drawings and the direction from the Architect. The mixing of the compound shall be as per manufacturer's specification. The same shall be applied post surface preparation and priming .
Surface preparation:- 
Providing and cleaning all floor surface to make it free from dirt, dust, loose particles, wax, polish, efflorescence, laitances and other contaminants by using wire brush, grinding all undulation to make the surface levelled, as per manufacturer's specification. 
Priming:- 
Providing and priming the surface with concentrated, synthetic, water-based, solvent-free multi-purpose primer, by diluting it with water in ratio of 1:3 for the first coat and allowing it to dry. Second coat of primer shall be applied by diluting in water in ratio of 1:1 and allowing it to dry. All procedures of application, including mixing and tools, shall comply with manufacturer's specification.                                                                                                                                                
Product Description:
The commercial grade self levelling compound shall consist of high quality special cement and selected fillers. The same shall be mixed with water at rate of 5.5-6 Ltr for 25 Kg bag, and installed using suitable pin rake trowel and notch trowel, as per manufacturer's instructions. The surface shall be rolled with spike roller and allowed to dry completely. 
The mandatory properties of the compound shall be as follows:-
Bulk density of powder: Approx. 1.3 kg / Ltr; Weight of fresh mortar: Approx. 2.0 kg / Ltr; Working time: Approx. 25 min; Flow life: Approx. 15 min; Initial set (Vicat): Approx. 40 min; Final set (Vicat) Approx 1 hr; Ball impact hardness: 6.5mm; Scratch hardness: 1.6mm; Compressive strength: 20 N / sqmm; Flexural strength: 3.5 N / Sqmm; VOC Content: 7.1 g/L]

Supply and installation of raised flooring system with access floor panels that are uniquely designed with hemispherical reinforcing pockets on the underside. The raised flooring system post installation shall ensure structural strength, durability and acoustic performance. The pedestal assembly of the raised flooring shall provide easy adjustment of leveling and accurately align panels for a maximum ± 25 mm in the vertical direction. The Pedestal head assembly shall consist of embossed head mechanically riveted to a rolled formed stud and 2 check nuts for level adjustment and arresting vertical movement. The pedestal head shall consist of an anti-vibration conductive cap with inbuilt isolating spacers for Panel and stringer location. The stringer shall be continuous box type, for strength, lateral stability, and for enhanced rolling loads performance and to support the panels on all four sides for alignment without leaving any gap at the pedestal head preventing air leakage. All steel components shall be Hot Dip Galvanized.
The Access Floor panel shall be of size 600 x 600 mm, shall be all steel welded construction with an enclosed bottom pan of hemispherical cones and the top plain sheet shall be fuse-welded at 144 locations to form a panel. The hollow panels shall be pretreated and coated with electrostatically deposited epoxy raisin 60 - 80 micron thick on all the exposed sides of the panel. The hollow core of the panel shall be injected with a light weight, fire retardant, noncombustible cementitious compound at high pressure to ensure support of not less than 90% of the top surface area of the panel. The panel shall be then laminated with floor grade Antistatic Laminate on a semi-automated lamination line to ensure maximum bonding to the steel surface. The edges of the laminated panel shall be an Integral trim without beeding. Expansion Joints to be considered for pricing. The uniformly distributed load capacity of the installed flooring shall be ~1650 kg/sqm.
Model: UNITILE or Equivalent, Size: 600 x 600 mm, Location :

Supply and installation of Type Partition of total thicknesss 100 mm comprising of GI stud framework along with 1 no. Gypsum board on both sides. Specifications of all parts are mentioned below:
GI stud framework:
The frame work shall comprise of GI Floor and Ceiling channel of dimension 72mm x 32mm x 32mm and 0.5mm thickness. The floor and ceiling channel shall be installed on site by fasteners as recommended by the manufacturer. The frame work shall consist of vertical GI 'C' Stud of dimension 70mm x 34mm x 36mm and 0.5 mm thickness, inserted into the floor channel and extending upto the ceiling channel, placed at a horizontal distance of 600mm c/c, fixed at both the floor and ceiling channel with applicable screws or fixing assembly, as recommended by the manufacturer. The framework shall consist of GI Nogging channels of dimension 70mm x 40mm x 40mm and 0.5mm thickness, placed horizontally at 1200mm c/c along the full height of the partition, fixed to the verticals GI 'C' stud with applicable screws / fixing assembly, as recommended by the manufacturer. The framework shall include all provisions for electrical conduiting, along with all necessary hardware for fixing switch boards, power sockets, etc, complete in all respects.
Boarding : 
The GI framework mentioned above shall be sandwitched in between boards. The board shall be ~12.5mm thick in totality, consisting of a gypsum core along with strong paper liners on either side. The same shall be screwed to the GI frame, confirming to the manufacturer's recommendations. The boards shall be full height, intalled from the base to the ceiling, with a 3mm gap, both at the floor and the ceiling junction, filled with caulking compound. The joints on the board shall be taped with mesh tape from 3M / equivalent and finished with jointing compound as per manufacturer's recommendation. The surface shall be sandrubbed, made smooth to remove any undulation to recieve intended finishes. All edges of the dry wall assemby shall be finished with galvanised metal angle bead and all unsupported gypsum board edges shall be finished with galvanised metal edge bead, confirming to manufacturer's recommendation. All installation, along with, jointing compound, taping, fixing mechanism, screws, plugs etc. shall be as per manufacturer's specification and the fixing methodology shall be confirming to the manufacturer's recommendation. 
Insulation : 
The wall assembly shall contain rock wool board insulation infill, composed of rock fibers processed from the molten state into fibrous form and bonded with fiber. The density of the rockwool insulation board shall be ~48kg/cum and the thickness of the same shall be ~50mm. The rockwool infill board shall be faced with aluminium foil. The insulation board shall extend upto the full height of the partition from the base upto the true ceiling. 
General:
Rates shall be inclusive of supply and installation of all materials mentioned above, including, all necessary fixing components, like, screws, plugs, etc. (confirming to manufacturer's specifications and installation recommendations), jointing compound, taping, etc; complete in all respects and made ready to recieve appropriate finishes. Rates shall be inclusive of all cut outs / fenestrations & provisions required on the dry wall partition including, but not limited to, HVAC ducting & grills, electrical conduiting, cable trays, sprinkler pipes, power points / switch boards, lighting sockets, speakers, etc. complete in all respects. The glass should be Contraflam Door Lite 11 mm clear 120 min fire rated and partially insulated (EW120), Non Wired Toughened Interlayered glass having a sound reduction of 37dB, LT of 86% and compliant to class 2(B)2 category of Impact Resistance as per EN 12600. The glass shall be able to withstand fire attack from both sides. The glass should be manufactured in UL & TUV audited Facility and including UL-EU Certification. The system shall be tested as per EN 1364-1 in Efectis, Nederland or any other international reputed laboratory.The profiles are manufactured from 1.6 mm galvanized steel sheet pressed formed to a profile of the dimension of 100 x 45 (overall dimension in mm) as per test evidence. The profile has to be fixed to the supporting construction by means of M10 or bigger steel bolts at every 150 mm from the edges and every 500 mm (approx) c/c. The glass should be held in its place with the help of minimum 1.6 mm GI beading which can be clamped or bolted to the profile by 4 mm x 35 mm steel screws at every 250 m c/c. Glazing tape Kerafix 2000 of the cross section of 5 mm x 20 mm shall be used as per the test evidence. The glass panes are to be supported on non combustible 5 mm Calcium Silicate setting blocks. The maximum glazing size cannot be more than 1100 mm x 2200 mm (w x h) or 2.42 sq mts in total area or can vary as per the test certification. The test report will be considered valid only if it contains the stamp and signature of the authorized signatory from Saint-Gobain Glass India Ltd.
